items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Keppard? Yeah, he was a trumpet player. He come here in around 1907 or '8.

ctx.x: Keppard? Yeah, he was a trumpet player. He come here in around 1907 or '8. Freddy Keppard and Jelly Roll's brother-in-law, Johnson, bass player...they came here, and Ernest Coycault--they call him Ernest Johnson, too. He came out here. A bunch of those Creoles came out of...about a year or so apart. They was one great trombone player went up North--Pappoose or something--they had all them Creole names. They all came through here '7...1907 or '8, '9, like that, you know.
How about Floyd Ray? He had a band here, didn't he?
